dct_description_sm: This polygon data layer represents the 356 voting wards in the City of Milwaukee, Wisconsin as of September 17, 2026. Attributes identify each ward's aldermanic district and associated polling place and include polling-place address, entrance, accessibility, and parking information. The source portal states that ward redistricting occurs every ten years following the census and that the dataset is refreshed nightly. The source shapefile is projected in NAD27 / Wisconsin South (EPSG:32054).
Original source: City of Milwaukee Open Data Portal.
